name: E3c_ml_transient
title: Match-line transient sensing and row crosstalk at the two drift-compensation nodes (lower-bound branch, sky130, nominal devices)

models.note: tt, 27 C; the E1 subset (byte-identical to the tt files of the corner subset)

circuit.criterion_quasi_static: V_sw = gate voltage at which the pull-down conducts 100 nA * W/L with V_DS = 1.8 V (E1-E3b); V_SL,nom = V_sw + D

ml.sources: C_SA 50 fF: Pedretti et al., Nat. Commun. 12, 5806 (2021), Methods; wire 1.0 fF per cell: Mohan & Sachdev, IEEE JSSC 2007 (145 fF for 145 bits, 0.18 um); V_ref = V_pre / 2: ML delay defined at 50 % of the precharge voltage (Pagiamtzis & Sheikholeslami, IEEE JSSC 2006)
ml.cells: each cell puts two pull-downs on the ML: the lower-branch pull-down (gate = divider node X) and the upper-branch pull-down (gate = inverter output, 0 V for a matched cell)
ml.precharge: ML held at v_pre during the DC operating point (.ic, no UIC), released at t = 0; inputs and divider nodes settled before t = 0
ml.sense_time: t_s(N) = time at which a row of N cells with the nominal cell-under-test pull-down at V_sw (and every other gate at 0 V) crosses v_ref; the nominal transient switching voltage therefore equals the quasi-static V_sw for every N, so the cell design of E1-E3b is unchanged

node_definitions.t0: PCM G(theta), V_SL,nom; input map M0
node_definitions.dac_1y: PCM a G(theta), V_SL,nom; input map Ma(x) = B_nom(a G(x))
node_definitions.supply_1y: PCM a G(theta), V_SL(t) = V_sw + D/a; input map M0

crosstalk.leakers: k other cells of the same design, lower bound theta_j = 0.5, input x_j = theta_j + d_lsb/15 (matched, d_lsb LSB inside); their divider nodes drive their lower-branch pull-downs; programmed nominally (no mismatch); the cell under test is programmed with all other gates at 0 V (threshold verify with the other cells strongly matched)

laws.T2: isolated cell: the transient bound equals the quasi-static bound (error 0) at every node
laws.T3: crosstalk shifts the switching level by delta_l = V_sw,tr(with leakers) - V_sw (pull-down-only transient, leaker gates at their DC divider voltages); input-referred shift = -15 (G/dG) kappa delta_l / D with kappa = 1 (t0, dac) and a (supply)
laws.T1: transient switching-voltage mismatch: sigma_tr from +-1 sigma transient sensitivities of the pull-down equals the quasi-static sigma_delta within 5 %

criteria.T1: |sigma_tr / sigma_qs - 1| <= 5 % for N = 1 and N = 16 (prediction written before the computation)
criteria.T2: isolated cell (N = 1 and 16): |error| <= 0.02 LSB for every design, theta and node
criteria.T3: crosstalk shift: |pred - sim| <= max(10 % sim, 0.02 LSB) for >= 90 % of the (design, configuration, node, theta) cases without predicted false mismatch
criteria.T4: supply node at 1 year has a smaller |crosstalk shift| than the input remap in every (design, configuration, theta) where both are defined
criteria.decision: validated if T2, T3 and T4 hold; T1 reported with its own verdict
criteria.checks: V_sw,nom identical in both phases; every configuration predicted to give a false mismatch also gives one in the full-branch simulation
